claim_type: impossibility theorem for a universal fixed-patch filter
limitations: Exact pure-state projection by a single fixed A- and n-independent linear patch operator only; A-dependent, n-dependent, approximate, multi-Kraus, or adaptive schemes are not ruled out.
provenance: SCOPE record repaired after independent three-axis audit; the product/cat/symmetric-power proof was independently rederived and targeted literature searches found no prior theorem with this exact universal-filter statement.
record_title: Cut-and-glue impossibility for homogeneous D=2 PEPS: no universal fixed-patch filter
